summary: First Mining Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting its Q1 2026 financial results and operating highlights. The filing describes routine quarterly performance, project updates (Springpole, Pickle Crow, Duparquet), and a closed asset sale (Cameron Gold Project to Seva Mining). No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is being announced; the report is a standard periodic update. The company is the issuer filing a foreign private issuer report under the 1934 Act.
